title: Onevra Mobile
summaryReady: Works with touch as it is.
summaryAdapt: Stays, with changes for touch and small screens.
summaryNative: Defers to the platform's own control.
summaryNew: A mobile component Onevra does not have yet.
summaryDesktop: No phone equivalent; another pattern replaces it.
noteButton: Keep touch targets at least 44 pt tall on iOS and 48 dp on Android.
noteIconButton: Touch has no hover, so the tooltip becomes a long-press label.
noteFloating: Matches floating toolbars and Android's floating action button.
noteHold: Press and hold maps to touch; add haptic feedback on confirmation.
noteTextBox: Needs the system text field for the keyboard, autofill and input methods; layouts move above the keyboard.
noteSwitch: The standard on and off control on both systems.
noteCheckbox: iOS has no check box: use a switch or a checkmark row.
noteRadio: iOS marks the chosen row of a list with a checkmark instead.
noteSlider: Dragging works as it is; enlarge the thumb's touch area.
noteNumberInput: Drag scrubbing conflicts with scrolling: keep the step buttons and a numeric keyboard.
noteSelect: Phones open the options as a sheet or a full-screen list rather than a drop-down.
noteNativeSelect: Maps to a pull-down menu on iOS and an exposed drop-down menu on Android.
noteTagInput: Tags stay; removing one needs a visible button rather than Backspace alone.
noteColor: iOS has a system color picker; Android shows Onevra's picker in a sheet.
noteTabs: Top-level sections become a floating tab bar on iPhone, with one prominent tab such as Search; segmented tabs stay within a screen.
noteSidebar: iOS 27 shows a sidebar on iPhone in landscape and on iPad; phones in portrait use the tab bar. Android uses a navigation rail or drawer instead.
noteBreadcrumbs: The navigation bar's back button replaces the trail.
noteSplit: Tablets only, as a list beside its detail.
noteCommand: Becomes a search screen opened from the navigation bar, without a keyboard shortcut.
noteList: Rows need a pressed state and swipe actions.
noteTree: Phones drill down one level per screen instead of expanding in place.
noteTable: Narrow screens scroll it horizontally or show each row as a card.
noteChart: Selection moves from hover to tap and drag.
noteChat: The composer must rise with the keyboard.
noteDisplay: Display only; works as it is.
noteDialog: Phones present it as a sheet; tablets as a centered form.
notePopover: iPhone presents popovers as sheets; tablets keep the anchored panel.
noteTooltip: Touch screens have no hover; show labels or long-press menus instead.
noteToast: Android has the snackbar; iOS has no system toast, so a custom banner remains.
noteSheet: Partial heights float inset on glass with corners concentric to the screen; close and confirm sit in glass circles.
noteNavigationStack: Pushed screens with a navigation bar, a back button and an edge swipe back.
noteTabBar: A floating glass tab bar that shrinks while content scrolls down, with an optional prominent tab, padded by the bottom safe area.
noteSafeArea: A container that pads content by the safe-area and keyboard insets while backgrounds reach the edges.
noteSwipeActions: Actions revealed by swiping a row sideways; iOS 27 offers them on any scrollable view.
notePullToRefresh: A refresh indicator pulled down from the top of a scroll view.
noteScrollEdge: Matches the scroll edge effect under iOS bars, hard by default since iOS 27; Android bars stay opaque or tint on scroll.
